audit.whatIsWrong: diff EVEN with the even-colour tone, while the page's own late/spikes[3] text says Swain flips the matchup outright at two items and the data shows 53.21% over 436 games.
audit.why: The mirror resolved this as FAVOURED with the matching tone; the shape is a lost lane that Swain wins after it.
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED, tone to the favoured colour, report[14].t reworded to match. diffRating left at 6/10 — the mirror did not name a new number and I would be guessing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill/Swain/Swain/Skill/Skill/Swain/Swain — it hands Swain five stages of a lane that every one of its own whys describes as Lucian's.
audit.why: whys[0] through whys[5] say Lucian's range is absolute, that he dashes through Nevermove, that he stands outside the W delay, and that he wins the first-item race. Only whys[6] is Swain's.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Lucian/Swain in matched full+content pairs, with ratings dropped to 4/10 on the Lucian rows and the five phase whys rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says 'track Relentless Pursuit' fourteen times without ever giving its cooldown, and never mentions that Lightslinger refunds it.
audit.why: Riot text: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, but 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown' — so the dash is almost never genuinely down while he is hitting things. That single fact is why 'engage when it's down' has been failing the reader. Lightslinger also turns his next attack into a double-shot after every ability, so the ability cast is the burst tell. The Culling is 110s at rank 1 with 1400 range.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, whys[1] and phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage when Relentless Pursuit is down' is the page's central instruction and it is close to unactionable as written.
audit.why: Because Lightslinger hits refund the dash, the real window is the moment AFTER he spends it in a trade, not a cooldown you can count from a scoreboard.
audit.corrected: Reworded to 'engage on a spent dash' across dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and phases[1].why.

edits.before: W-poke and AA harass win the range war. Identify how Lucian contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His double-shot punishes every last-hit and you have no root yet — take the poke tax and farm at range.

edits.before: E-root into the pull is your whole kill setup. Only take the trade when Lucian's Relentless Pursuit is down.
edits.after: E is online, but Relentless Pursuit dashes clean through the sweep — throw it only after the dash is spent.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Lucian must walk into your range.
edits.after: He stands outside your W delay and leaves the slow before the root returns — bank fragments, not trades.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Relentless Pursuit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His item spike plus range means you cannot land E on his terms — farm safe, and note his dash refunds off Lightslinger hits.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.
edits.after: He out-paces your first item — his poke lands before your burst is online, so hold E for his committed step-up.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger hit shaves it — it is rarely truly down. - Lightslinger: every ability he casts turns his next attack into a double-shot. - The Culling: 110s at rank 1, 1400 range.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. When it is down — E-root + W pull drain.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s but Lightslinger hits refund it — root him on the return sweep after the dash is spent.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1, but his attacks keep shaving it. Engage on a spent dash.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 6/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: E comes online but Relentless Pursuit lets him dash clean through Nevermove mid-cast — he fishes for your missed root and punishes with a full auto-Q-auto burst cycle.
edits.after: E comes online but Relentless Pursuit dashes clean through Nevermove — and Lightslinger hits keep shaving its 16s, so it is rarely down when you want it to be.

notes: Lightslinger's second clause — bonus damage when a nearby enemy champion is immobilised — triggers on YOU being immobilised, not on Lucian being rooted, so it is a support-CC interaction rather than a Nevermove one. I deliberately did not write it as 'your root arms his passive', which would be backwards. diffRating stayed at 6/10 while diff became FAVOURED: the mirror named the enum change but no new number, and inventing one would put the enum, the rating and report[14] out of step again.
